title: 5-Day Hua Hin Seaside Golf, Craft Cocktails & Nightlife
description: Vibrant seaside golf based at The Standard, Hua Hin. Play Black Mountain, Pineapple Valley, and Lake View with lively beachfront dining.

signatureTour.title: The Bangkok & Hua Hin Fairways
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our flagship 9-day tour pairing The Standard, Hua Hin with luxury penthouse living in Bangkok.

inclusions.detail: Chauffeured executive transport between Bangkok and Hua Hin.
3 rounds: Black Mountain, Pineapple Valley, and Lake View.
4 nights in a Canopy Villa or Pool Villa at The Standard, Hua Hin.
Reserved seating and craft cocktails at the vibrant beachfront Lido bar.
On-ground assistance with tee times, buggies, and dining bookings.

itinerary.title: Executive Transit from Bangkok & Beachfront Lido Welcome
itinerary.subtitle: Seaside Arrival
itinerary.imageCaption: The Standard Hua Hin — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: The Standard Hua Hin luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Travel via executive transfer from Bangkok to The Standard, Hua Hin, the design-forward beachfront resort set amidst lush tropical gardens. Check into your stylish villa and take in the vibrant coastal atmosphere.

Head to the beachfront Lido bar for welcome craft cocktails, followed by fresh Thai seafood and tapas at Praça, the restored heritage beach pavilion.

itinerary.title: Championship Golf at Black Mountain Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: European Tour Challenge
itinerary.imageCaption: Black Mountain Golf Club — Phil Ryan (Par 72, 7,375 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Black Mountain Golf Club championship golf course Phil Ryan Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Black Mountain Golf Club, Hua Hin’s most celebrated layout. Granite bluffs frame manicured fairways that demand precision and confidence off the tee.

Return to The Standard for an afternoon pool session with cold local beers, followed by dinner in Hua Hin town.

itinerary.title: Scenic Rolling Fairways at Pineapple Valley Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Schmidt-Curley Layout
itinerary.imageCaption: Pineapple Valley Golf Club — Pirapon Namatra / Golf East (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Pineapple Valley Golf Club championship golf course Pirapon Namatra / Golf East Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Play Pineapple Valley Golf Club, navigating contoured fairways carved through historic pineapple plantations with breathtaking mountain backdrops.

Enjoy sunset drinks at the hilltop clubhouse before returning to Hua Hin for an evening of craft cocktails and live music along the beach.

itinerary.title: 36-Hole Complex at Lake View Resort & Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Mountain & Lake Challenge
itinerary.imageCaption: Lake View Resort & Golf Club — Roger Packard (Par 72 (any 18 combination), 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Lake View Resort & Golf Club championship golf course Roger Packard Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tackle the scenic 36-hole complex at Lake View Resort & Golf Club. The combination of water hazards and rolling mountain terrain delivers an enjoyable and strategic test.

Gather for a tour-ending farewell dinner at Praça, enjoying innovative Thai dishes and fine wines beside the breaking waves.

itinerary.title: Morning Beach Walk & Return to Bangkok Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: The Standard Hua Hin — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: The Standard Hua Hin luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast and a final stroll along Hua Hin beach before checking out.

Your private executive transfer transports your party directly to Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport for your flight home.

faqs.question: Is The Standard, Hua Hin walkable to local bars and restaurants?
faqs.answer: Yes, the resort is conveniently located within a 5-10 minute walk of Hua Hin’s town center, night market, and local restaurants.
